code.description:
The problem code of its error (`SH1002`), or of its failure when
it ran and failed on the setup (`doctor`); `shuyi explain <code>`
prints its page.

error.description: Why it could not run, if it could not.

help.description: How to fix it, with the code.

limits.description: What it could not determine, in plain words.

ok.description:
Whether it passed: nothing found by a check, runs that agree, a
game made, a toolchain complete. False too when it could not run.

result.description: What it found or made; absent when it could not run.

AddOutput.description: What `add` did, and what is left to the game.

about.description: What it is for: its README's first paragraph.

alternatives_on.description: Its alternatives the game already has on.

beside.description: Its README's section on sitting beside them, when one is on.

changed.description:
Whether the game's `Cargo.toml` changed; `false` when the module
was on already.

formats.description: The line for the game's `formats()`, when the module adds formats.

install.description:
The line to add to the game's code, when it never installs the
modules it turns on.

skill.description:
Where its skill was copied, from the game's folder; absent when
none was (the limits say why).
